cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
def run_raw(req):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-u","/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                       input=json.dumps(req,separators=(",",":")).encode(),
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp")
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[:500]
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

topo = {"nodes":[{"id":0,"name":"A","external_capacity":100},{"id":1,"name":"B","external_capacity":100}],
        "links":[{"source":0,"target":1,"capacity":100}],"external_nodes":["A","B"]}
S = {"trials":2,"epsilon":0,"seed":7,"cutoff":[9,2],"bias":0,"tau":0,"gamma":[1,1],"cache_slots":2}
COUNTS = {"low_A_egress_to_B":{"perturbed":10},"low_B_ingress_from_A":{"perturbed":10},
          "low_B_egress_to_A":{"perturbed":3},"low_A_ingress_from_B":{"perturbed":3},
          "low_A_origination":{"perturbed":10},"low_A_termination":{"perturbed":3},
          "low_B_origination":{"perturbed":3},"low_B_termination":{"perturbed":10}}
def cstate(v):
    c = dict(COUNTS); c["low_A_egress_to_B"] = {"perturbed": v}; return c
ROUTES = {"A":{"B":[{"path":["A","B"],"weight":1000}]},"B":{"A":[{"path":["B","A"],"weight":1000}]}}
evs = [
    {"op":"patch","demands":[[0,1,10],[1,0,3]],"counters":cstate(10)},  # k1
    {"op":"routes","label":"L","paths":ROUTES},
    {"op":"repair","id":"y"},                                          # miss (k1 repair)
    {"op":"patch","demands":[],"counters":cstate(11)},                 # k2 (demands preserved!)
    {"op":"repair","id":"z"},                                          # miss (k2 repair)
    {"op":"repair","id":"y"},                                          # HIT (k2) -> replaces snapshot y
    {"op":"validate","id":"y"},
    {"op":"validate","id":"z"},
    {"op":"validate","id":"z"},
]
out = run_raw({"streams":[{"topology":topo,"settings":S,"events":evs}]})["streams"][0]["events"]
assert [e["cache_hit"] for e in out if e["op"]=="repair"] == [False, False, True]
# k1 repair: (0,1) conf 5/1; k2 repair: (0,1) conf 4/1. cutoff 9/2 keeps only conf>=5.
assert out[2]["links"] != out[4]["links"], "k1 and k2 repairs must differ"
assert out[5]["links"] == out[4]["links"], "hit returns k2's repair"
# snapshot y replaced by k2's repair -> only (1,0) conf 5 clears the cutoff:
want = {"op":"validate","id":"y","checked":2,"passed":2,"consistent":True,"failed":[]}
assert out[6] == want, out[6]   # stale k1 snapshot would instead check 4 cells
strip = lambda e: {k: v for k, v in e.items() if k != "id"}
assert strip(out[6]) == strip(out[7]) == strip(out[8])
print("PASS cache hit replaces snapshot; validate idempotent & cutoff-filtered (hand-verified)")
EOF
